extension.summary: Plex's free, ad-supported Movies & Shows and Live TV (unofficial)
extension.description:
Browse and play the free on-demand movies and TV shows Plex streams from its own cloud. No Plex Media Server and no account needed; signing in with plex.tv/link is optional and only syncs watch progress to your Plex account.
Live TV: Plex's free live channels (about 700 in the US) by genre, with what's on now and next, and in Kodi's TV guide through IPTV Manager (optional).
Clear titles play as HLS; Widevine-protected titles play as DASH through InputStream Adaptive (SD on most L3 devices).
The catalogue is region-limited (mainly the US). Plex refuses some titles from VPN or datacenter addresses. This add-on does not play Plex's ads. Rentals and purchases made on Plex's own apps or site play here once you sign in; renting is not possible from Kodi.
Unofficial; not affiliated with or endorsed by Plex, Inc.
